authenticity.a: Every pair is inspected point by point by our experts before dispatch. We guarantee 100% authenticity on all our products, with an authentication certificate included. No replicas, no doubt.

shipping.a: Tracked delivery 24/7 across Tunisia. Parcels within 24-48 business hours in Tunis and the greater Tunis area, 2-4 business days elsewhere in the country. International shipping available on request. A tracking number is emailed as soon as your order ships.

returns.a: 14 days to change your mind. Free returns in Tunisia. The pair must be returned in its original condition, with all tags and the box. Refunded within 72 hours of receiving the return.

sizing.a: Every size from EU 39 to 47 is in stock. Check our size guide to find your exact size. If you are torn between two sizes, we recommend going with the larger one.

payment.a: Cash on delivery. You pay in cash when your order is delivered — no card details required.

about.title: The Journal
about.lead: The story of the district, our sources, our obsessions.
about.intro: Q2M started in a back room with three boxes and a single rule — never sell what we would not wear ourselves. Today we move limited pairs for people who treat the shoe as the last build they will ever wear.
about.pillar1Body: Every piece is inspected, weighed and registered before it reaches the vault. Never a replica.
about.pillar2Body: We buy allocations, not leftovers. Members see new colourways before anyone else.
about.pillar3Body: Tracked priority delivery in 40+ countries with a 48 h window on every order.
about.pillar4Body: Deadstock is put back in circulation instead of buried. Trade-ins credit your next pair.
about.metaDescription: The story of the district, our sources, our obsessions. Sneakers curated in Paris.

terms.title: Terms and conditions of sale
terms.metaDescription: Q2M terms of sale: ordering, cash on delivery, shipping across Tunisia, returns and refunds.
terms.intro: These terms govern sales made on the Q2M store. Placing an order implies full acceptance of them.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.body: These terms and conditions of sale govern the sale of sneakers and items offered on the Q2M online store. They apply to any order placed on the site, in Tunisia and internationally.

sections.heading: 2. Products and availability
sections.body:
Products are described and pictured as accurately as possible. Images are indicative and may show slight variations.

Offers are valid while stocks last. If an item is unavailable, we inform you before shipping and offer a solution.

sections.heading: 3. Prices
sections.body: Prices are shown in Tunisian dinars (TND), taxes included, excluding shipping. Q2M may change its prices at any time; the applicable price is the one displayed when the order is confirmed.

sections.heading: 4. Ordering and confirmation
sections.body: Every order is confirmed by phone before shipping. Together we check the delivery address, size and availability. An unconfirmed order cannot be shipped.

sections.heading: 5. Payment
sections.body: Payment is made exclusively in cash on delivery (pay on receipt). No card number is ever requested or stored on the site.

sections.heading: 6. Shipping
sections.body:
Confirmed orders are prepared within 24 business hours. We deliver across Tunisia: 24 to 48 business hours in Tunis and its region, 2 to 4 business days elsewhere.

Shipping is free on orders over 200 TND; below that, a flat shipping fee is shown at checkout. International shipping is available on request.

sections.heading: 7. Authenticity guarantee
sections.body: All items sold by Q2M are authentic. An invoice is issued for every order. Where an item is sold second-hand, this is stated clearly.

sections.heading: 8. Right of return and withdrawal
sections.body: You have 14 days from receipt to return an unworn item in its original condition (tags and box included). Return shipping is at our expense within Tunisia. Refunds are issued within 72 hours of receiving and checking the item.

sections.heading: 9. Liability
sections.body: Q2M cannot be held liable for damage resulting from abnormal use of the products or for delays attributable to the carrier. Our liability is limited to the order amount.

sections.heading: 10. Intellectual property
sections.body: All site content (text, images, logo) is protected. Any reproduction without prior written permission is prohibited.

sections.heading: 11. Governing law and disputes
sections.body: These terms are governed by Tunisian law. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution is sought first through our customer service.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
sections.body: For any question about an order or these terms, contact our customer service through the Contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaTitle: Privacy — How we protect your data | Q2M
privacy.metaDescription: How Q2M collects and protects your personal data: purposes, retention, recipients, cookies and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data we collect, why, and how you can exercise your rights.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body: Q2M is the data controller for personal data collected on the site.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
sections.body:
We collect the data needed to process your order: first and last name, phone number, email address, delivery address and cart contents.

We also keep your order history to support you with tracking and after-sales service.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal basis
sections.body: Your data is used to process and deliver your orders, to contact you for confirmation, to provide customer service and, with your consent, to measure site traffic.

sections.heading: 4. Retention
sections.body: Order data is kept for as long as necessary to manage the business relationship and meet our legal obligations.

sections.heading: 5. Recipients
sections.body: Your contact details are shared with the carrier handling delivery. We never sell or rent your data to third parties.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and analytics
sections.body: Technical cookies keep the cart working and remember your consent. Analytics tools and the advertising pixel are only activated after you accept.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, deletion of or restriction of the processing of your data, and object to its processing. Requests are made through the Contact page.

cookies.title: Cookie management
cookies.metaDescription: Which cookies Q2M uses, which are essential, and how to accept or decline analytics and advertising.
cookies.intro: We use no advertising tracker without your consent. Here is, transparently, what the site stores on your device.

sections.heading: 1. What is a cookie?
sections.body: A cookie is a small file placed on your device that keeps information between visits: cart contents, language preferences or your consent choice.

sections.heading: 2. Strictly necessary cookies
sections.body: The cart, the session and the memory of your choice rely on the browser local storage. These mechanisms are essential to the site and stay active without consent.

sections.heading: 3. Analytics and advertising
sections.body: Visit statistics and the Meta advertising pixel are loaded only after you accept. As long as you have not accepted, no data is sent to these services.

sections.heading: 4. Managing your choice
sections.body: The banner at the bottom of the page lets you accept or decline. To change your choice later, clear your browser site data: the banner will appear again.

returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.metaDescription: 14-day returns, conditions, free return shipping in Tunisia, refunds within 72 hours and exchanges subject to stock.
returns.intro: Changing your mind is easy: you have 14 days to return an item that meets our conditions.

sections.heading: 1. Return window
sections.body: You have 14 days from receipt to return an item to us.

sections.heading: 2. Conditions
sections.body: The item must be unworn, in its original condition, with its tags and box. Returns that are incomplete or damaged may be refused.

sections.heading: 3. How to return an item
sections.body: Contact our customer service through the Contact page or report the return from your account. We will then tell you what to do.

sections.heading: 4. Return shipping
sections.body: Return shipping is at our expense anywhere in Tunisia.

sections.heading: 5. Refunds
sections.body: After receiving and checking the item, we issue the refund within 72 hours. Depending on the original payment method, it is made in cash or by bank transfer.

sections.heading: 6. Exchanges
sections.body: Prefer another size or colour? Exchanges are possible while stocks last: contact us to check availability.
